title: Catalog: tests
purpose: Find the exact analyte, method version, matrix and unit combination used to request work. Receipt offers it only while both test and method version are active.

sections.title: Access and navigation
paragraphs: Active staff with a laboratory role can read the lists. Client portal accounts cannot. Only the admin role creates or edits catalog records.

items.label: Tests
items.description: Combinations of analyte, method version and matrix available for requesting work.

items.label: Methods
items.description: Laboratory method versions that tests and batches refer to.

items.label: Analytes
items.description: Substances or properties measured by tests.

items.label: New test
items.description: Administrators open the creation form. Create its method version and analyte first.

items.label: Analyte row link
items.description: Administrators open this test’s edit form; other staff see plain text.

items.label: Spreadsheet import
items.description: Administrators can also create or change many tests at once from a CSV file under Setup → Spreadsheet import, with a row-by-row preview and the same checks, locks and history as this form.

items.label: Search
items.description: Searches analyte name, method code, method title and unit; not method version or CAS number.

items.label: Method
items.description: One exact version, including inactive versions for history.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Water, Wastewater or Soil.

items.label: Status
items.description: Available at receipt requires active test and method. Test active and Test inactive consider only the test flag. Any status includes all records.

items.label: Method code
items.description: More filters: exact code across versions.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: More filters: one exact analyte.

items.label: Analyte group
items.description: More filters: tests whose analyte belongs to one group from the fixed list. Analytes with Not recorded match only when the filter is blank.

items.label: Unit
items.description: More filters: one exact existing unit spelling.

items.label: Default limit
items.description: More filters: Has a default limit or No default limit.

items.label: Requested on samples
items.description: More filters: Yes means at least one received requested test refers to this definition; No means none.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Measured substance/property. Default sort is analyte name ascending.

items.label: Method version
items.description: Code and version with method title below.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Matrix this definition accepts.

items.label: Unit
items.description: Exact unit text; the system does not convert units.

items.label: Reporting limit
items.description: Configured default in this unit, shown without storage-padding zeros. Blank means no default, not zero. Each result records the limit actually used.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active means both flags are active; Method inactive means the test is active but its method is not; Inactive means the test flag is off.

items.label: Technique
items.description: Initially hidden measurement technique of the test’s method version, or a dash when not recorded.

items.label: Analyte group
items.description: Initially hidden group of the test’s analyte, or a dash when not recorded.

items.label: Requested on samples
items.description: Initially hidden count of received requests referring to the definition.

items.label: Last changed
items.description: Initially hidden time of the newest audit event for this definition; a dash means none recorded.

sections.title: Using the table
paragraphs: Invalid filters leave the table empty with errors until corrected or cleared. A no-match state differs from an empty catalog. Administrators see the relevant New action in an empty catalog.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Combines search and filters across all records and starts at page 1. Search is case-insensitive and matches contained text.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Opens additional criteria and stays open when they are used or invalid.

items.label: Clear all and filter chips
items.description: Clear all restores the unfiltered URL and default sort. Removing one chip clears that criterion and starts at page 1 while keeping the other criteria.

items.label: Column headings
items.description: Linked headings sort the full filtered set; record ID breaks ties. Unsupported sort values fall back to the default.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show, hide or reorder optional columns; the identifying column stays visible. Preferences belong to this browser. Reset restores the default presentation without changing records or filters.

items.label: Rows per page and pagination
items.description: Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows; use Show if automatic submission is unavailable. A size change starts at page 1. First, Previous, Next and Last preserve filters and sort; the result count describes the filtered set.

items.label: Column checkboxes
items.description: Changes apply immediately. Check to show an optional column or uncheck to hide it. Always shown columns are fixed.

items.label: Move column up / down
items.description: Moves an optional column within the displayed order; the first/last position disables the unavailable move. You can also drag movable table headers.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restores this table’s default order and visibility in this browser.

items.label: Done / Close
items.description: Closes the dialog; layout changes have already been applied and saved locally. No laboratory record is changed.
